LanguageData.RadiologyBlocker.label: radiation blocker
LanguageData.RadiologyBlocker.description: Lets you set up a filter that will block a large amount of radiation directed at certain body parts. This blocker has 40% chance to deflect radiation and lets you select up to two body parts.
LanguageData.RadiologyBlockerAdvanced.label: advanced radiation blocker
LanguageData.RadiologyBlockerAdvanced.description: Lets you set up a filter that will block a large amount of radiation directed at certain body parts. This blocker has 80% chance to deflect radiation and lets you select up to four body parts.
LanguageData.RadiologyBlockerIntermediate.label: intermediate radiation blocker
LanguageData.RadiologyBlockerIntermediate.description: Lets you set up a filter that will block a large amount of radiation directed at certain body parts. This blocker has 60% chance to deflect radiation and lets you select up to three body parts.
LanguageData.RadiologyExtender.label: radiation extender
LanguageData.RadiologyExtender.description: A device that collects incoming radiation from all directions and redirects it forward with minimal dissipation, allowing you to place irradiators at a larger distance away from the target.
LanguageData.RadiologyFilter.label: radiation filter
LanguageData.RadiologyFilter.description: Lets you set up a filter that will alter the radiation going through it.
LanguageData.RadiologyIrradiator.label: irradiator
LanguageData.RadiologyIrradiator.description: Bombard your colonists with harmful radiation.
LanguageData.RadiologyIrradiatorIntermediate.label: intermediate irradiator
LanguageData.RadiologyIrradiatorIntermediate.descript: Bombard your colonists with less harmful radiation.
LanguageData.RadiologyMonitor.label: radiation monitor
LanguageData.RadiologyMonitor.description: Displays the amount of radiation dispensed at radiation chamber.
LanguageData.RadiologyMonitorMutation.label: mutation monitor
LanguageData.RadiologyMonitorMutation.description: Displays the last mutation created at a chamber.
LanguageData.RadiologyRadiationChamber.label: irradiation chamber
LanguageData.RadiologyRadiationChamber.description: A place to stand on for a prescripted dose of radiation.
